title: This Animal Builds Free Homes for Warthogs and Bats Without Knowing It
subject: aardvark

scenes.text: This animal builds houses for warthogs, jackals and bats. It never gets paid.
The aardvark. At night it visits around 200 ant and termite nests, with a tongue up to 30 centimeters long.
In one night it can trap up to 50,000 termites and ants.
By day it sleeps in a burrow it dug itself, with spade-shaped claws.
Then it moves on. Warthogs, porcupines, jackals and bats take over the empty burrows.
One digger, and the whole neighborhood gets a home.

description:
The aardvark digs burrows that other animals move into.
It eats up to 50,000 ants and termites a night and sleeps in burrows it digs with spade-shaped claws. When it moves on, warthogs, porcupines, jackals, black-footed cats and bats take over.
Which animal would you most like as a neighbor?
first_comment: Aardvark means earth pig in Afrikaans. What's the strangest animal landlord you know?
